text: Brent closed at 92.14 USD/bbl on 2026-11-11, a change of 2.2% from 90.16 USD/bbl the previous day, which is also the 1-month low. The price is 0.3% higher over one week, but the change over one month is -29.1%, measured from a 1-month high of 129.95 USD/bbl, and the facts give no reason for these moves. In Egypt, the bid deadline for the 14-block EGAS and EGPC rounds was extended to 14 Dec 2026, and the West Zohr Offshore block was promoted ahead of that December deadline. In Libya, the NOC announced a new licensing round, listed with a date of 2026-11-20, and none of these headlines is tied to the Brent move.
